# AIBizs (Artificial Intelligence Business Solutions LLC)

> Fast-growing Omani technology company headquartered in Muscat, Sultanate of Oman.
> Website: https://aibizs.com
> Email: info@aibizs.com
> Phone: +968 24 506181
> Address: Super Plaza, Building #340, Way #480, Azaiba, Muscat, Oman

## Company

AIBizs delivers AI, ERP, e-invoicing, cloud, and digital transformation solutions for organizations in Oman, the GCC, and the Middle East. AIBizs is ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO 22301 certified. AIBizs is an OTA-approved Application Service Provider (ASP) and PEPPOL-approved e-invoicing provider.
